games.title: Chess vs AI
games.author: zserge
games.description: A minimalist chess game with Stockfish AI. Play against different difficulty levels with a clean, modern interface. Features include move hints, undo, and the ability to play as black or white.

games.title: Die in the Dungeon
games.author: Alarts
games.description: Die in the Dungeon is a deck-building, turn-based roguelike where you dont use cards, but dice! Try to find the best combination to conquer the 2X-floor dungeon, but be careful, a frog like you can only get so far before encountering a prey too big to swallow...

games.title: Folder Dungeon
games.author: Ravernt
games.description: Folder Dungeon is dungeon crawler roguelike inside computer folder! Make difficult decisions, fight enemies, collect powerful relics! Play in full screen or download the game for best experience!

games.title: Slipways Classic
games.author: Jakub Wasilewski
games.description: The PC version is now available! This is the original PICO-8 edition of a larger game. It's pay-what-you-want - all money earned here goes towards development of my other games.

games.title: Shogun Showdown - Alpha
games.author: Roboatino
games.description: Shogun Showdown is a turn-based combat game with rogue-like and deck-building elements. This is the Alpha-version of the game.

games.title: Backpack Hero
games.author: Thejaspel
games.description: Backpack Hero is the inventory management roguelike! Collect rare items, organize your bag, and vanquish your foes! Delve into the dungeon with your magic backpack!

games.title: Solitomb
games.author: Jakub Wasilewski
games.description: You are an adventurer who entered into a pact with a demon. Use your solitaire skills to assemble powerful combos and defeat the dungeon's monsters.

games.title: Porklike
games.author: Krystman
games.description: Wurst Comes to Worst - Porklike is a classic, turn-based Roguelike with minimalist lo-fi aesthetic. Enter the tower of Wurstlord. Can you make it to the top and steal his legendary Kielbasa?
